status_ladder.proved: Analytic argument supplied; external theorem dependencies explicit.
status_ladder.exactly_checked: Finite certificate reconstructed with exact arithmetic.
status_ladder.not_claimed: Formal verification, fresh independent refereeing, complete unrestricted classification, confirmed priority, or an official REF grade.

claims.title: Exact field-eliminated quotient
claims.statement: For leading-rigid Hermitian swap-symmetric h, quotient vanishing iff some fields admit an exact-range-three Q with commutator range at most two; homogeneous fields suffice for every N >= 6.
claims.status: proved with stated dependencies; finite algebra checked where applicable
claims.proof_or_evidence: Analytic proof: anti-Hermitian normalisation, averaging leading equations, reversal projection, local converse.

claims.title: Multiplicity-free symmetry evaluation
claims.statement: For irreducible compact G with multiplicity-free V tensor V and invariant leading-rigid h, U(h)=Delta(h); nonzero Delta excludes all stated higher-range charges for every site-dependent Hermitian field.
claims.status: proved with stated dependencies; finite algebra checked where applicable
limits: No unconditional claim for rank-deficient higher-spin interactions.

claims.title: Isotropic polynomial identity
claims.status: proved with stated dependencies; finite algebra checked where applicable
claims.proof_or_evidence: Full symbolic identity plus separately implemented four integer coefficient matrices.
limits: Cartesian basis and unnormalised traces fixed.

claims.title: Rank-deficient leading rigidity
claims.statement: Both h(1,0) and h(1,2) have one-dimensional local pair kernels and injective endpoints.
claims.status: proved with stated dependencies; finite algebra checked where applicable
claims.proof_or_evidence: 127-minors modulo 101, known exact kernel vectors, and rank-8 boundary maps.
limits: Ranks proved over characteristic zero, not inferred from vanishing modular minors.

claims.title: Complete isotropic field-existence criterion
claims.statement: For nonzero h(u,v), some fields admit a conserved charge of range 3..floor(N/2) iff u*(u-v)*(u+v)=0. Off those lines every field choice is excluded, for every N >= 6.
claims.status: proved with stated dependencies; finite algebra checked where applicable
claims.proof_or_evidence: Analytic symmetry theorem, polynomial identity, rank-deficient closure, telescoping positive-ray current.
limits: Does not classify every individual field on the three charge-admitting lines.

claims.title: Exact residual isotropic local commutant
claims.statement: Off the three charge-admitting lines, all charges of range <= floor(N/2) are I, H and uniform spin generators commuting with every field.
claims.status: proved with stated dependencies; finite algebra checked where applicable
claims.proof_or_evidence: Analytic bond-stabilizer proof using transpose-parity sectors and distinct squared sector eigenvalues.
limits: No claim outside the stated range.

claims.title: Retained unrestricted generic theorem
claims.statement: An open dense full-measure interaction set in every d >= 3 has local commutant span(I,H), for all N >= 6 and all fields.
claims.status: proved with stated dependencies; finite algebra checked where applicable
claims.proof_or_evidence: Cubic witness and nonzero polynomial argument; higher-d embedding.

claims.title: Generic coverage of both diagonal blind hypersurfaces
claims.statement: Relative Zariski-open full-measure regular subsets of j3=3*j8 and j4*j5=j6*j7 have local commutant span(I,H) under every field choice.
claims.status: proved with stated dependencies; finite algebra checked where applicable
claims.proof_or_evidence: Two 37-minors, degree-47 restriction argument, abelian-eigenspace short-charge lemma.
limits: Inside the fixed eight-parameter diagonal-G family; not the full 36-parameter exceptional locus.

claims.title: Retained robust neighbourhood
claims.statement: The Frobenius ball of radius 1/10 around h_star, within canonical Hermitian swap-symmetric interactions, has the full commutant conclusion.
claims.status: proved with stated dependencies; finite algebra checked where applicable
claims.proof_or_evidence: Norm difference bound 8570.4 < sqrt(81962496), spectral separation.
